intent.problem: The installer now has an interactive wizard, but the shell entrypoint must route interactive invocations without changing explicit legacy CLI behavior or blocking in non-TTY automation.

Explicit installer options retain their existing parser and output behavior.
No-argument non-TTY exits fail closed without waiting; no lifecycle automation is added.
intent.rationale: A small entrypoint compatibility layer makes the new wizard discoverable while keeping deterministic automation and existing integrations stable.
